settings.content: The one list of the store's home collections. The product page walks it in this order to find a related collection with more than one product; a home category block with no collection chosen falls back to the collection whose handle matches its title.

settings.info: Rules separated by semicolons, each written as collection-handle: keyword, keyword. On a thin search result the first rule with a keyword in the search terms supplies the suggested collection. Only handles from the list above count.

settings.content: The product page availability banner and the delivery block show the UK line only to visitors whose market country is the United Kingdom; every other market sees the neutral line. Keep both true: nothing here is verified against the carrier.

settings.label: Delivery line for UK visitors
settings.default: Free UK delivery on every order. Tracking details are sent after dispatch.

settings.label: Delivery line for other markets
settings.default: Delivery options and times are shown at checkout.

settings.info: Shown in the confirmation box after a visitor submits the contact form, e.g. "We usually reply within 24 hours".

settings.label: Event pop-up slot
settings.info: Master switch for the storewide event pop-up. It opens once per visitor per event (after 3 seconds or their first scroll) and only while PawScout reports a running storewide event; the headline, wording, code and end date all come from that event, so there is nothing to type here. Leave it on unless you never want an offer pop-up.
